scope: all current and future Powerhouse chats, agents, skills, workflows, CRM/connectors, portal surfaces and intelligence producers
problem: Powerhouse already contained context, graph, action, outcome and learning components, but they were distributed across domain-specific projections and lacked one mandatory company-intelligence semantic contract.
root_cause: Canonical data and closed-loop machinery existed while Company Graph, System of Context, autonomous action, Outcome Memory and Compound Intelligence were not governed as one operating layer.
proven_fix: Company Intelligence OS v1 is deployed as a derived semantic/runtime layer over existing canonical stores. CRM remains a source; no duplicate truth store exists. Production readback proves all five layers plus the canonical orchestrator are present and populated.
prevention: Every company/customer intelligence feature attaches to Company Intelligence OS or documents why it cannot.
CRM integrations feed evidence/context and never become competing reasoning authority.
Action mechanisms reuse the canonical sales/action/agent fabric and explicit execution boundaries.
Observed outcomes land in canonical outcome/realized-value lineage with evidence.
Predicted or expected value never becomes realized value without evidence.
Learning is incomplete until it changes a later priority, prediction, policy or next-best-action.
System Map, human docs, skills and tests update in the same delivery lineage.
The canonical Company Intelligence OS skill must explicitly require production readback before terminal closure.
